env.name: NOTIFICATIONS_ENVIRONMENT_ID
env.value: env_… (a live environment of COSS's own organization)
env.description: Sends account emails (sign-up verification, password resets, invitations) and reputation notifications through COSS itself (worker); neither the worker nor admins (dashboard) may suspend its organization. Unset until COSS's organization has a verified domain: both are held, and nobody can verify their email address.

env.description: Stripe API key: the dashboard opens Checkout and the portal, the worker invoices.

env.value: The signing secret of the Stripe webhook endpoint https://coss.com/api/billing/webhook

oneOffTasks.name: migrate
oneOffTasks.when: Before every deploy, alone (never two at once). Needs only DATABASE_URL.

oneOffTasks.name: ses-bootstrap
oneOffTasks.when: Once per stage after the first migrate, and after upgrades that change it. Needs DATABASE_URL, AWS_REGION and a task role allowed to manage SES, SNS, SQS, EventBridge, IAM and CloudWatch.

oneOffTasks.name: create-admin
oneOffTasks.when: Once, after that user signed up: makes them a platform admin. Run with the api service's environment.

oneOffTasks.name: webhooks-reencrypt
oneOffTasks.when: When rotating WEBHOOK_SECRETS_KEY, after every service runs with the new key first: moves endpoint secrets onto it so older keys can be removed. Needs DATABASE_URL and WEBHOOK_SECRETS_KEY.
